description: A filed.fyi mascot record: the shared filed prelude (closed boris frontmatter), the `# title` heading and `**Role:**` card, then the canon skeleton in order — Image, Biography, Origin Myth, Defining Failure, Aspirational Goal, Signature Quirk, Relationship Network, Day in the Life, Mood Calibration, the personal verse log, Known System Messages — followed by the upgrade apparatus (Field Testimony quotes with footnotes, a Field Notes palette, the Provenance Ledger, Annotations). Canon bodies are verbatim extracted strings; `extra_sections` re-emits captured non-canon sections after the canon slot they followed. Section headings and callout/table chrome belong to the template; values only.

title.role: record title; frontmatter `title` and the `#` heading when title_heading is set

title_heading.role: non-empty when the record carries its own `# <title>` heading; extraction sets it

card.role: the verbatim `**Role:**/…` label block after the title heading

image.role: ## Image body: the mascot's alt-text, verbatim

defining_failure.role: ## Defining Failure body, verbatim (records may spell it 'Defining Failure/Trauma')

relationships.role: ## Relationship Network bullets, one each; existing entries may carry [[wikilinks]], new entries are plain prose

day_in_life.role: ## Day in the Life body, verbatim (records may say '… Vignette')

verse_heading.role: verbatim heading text of the personal verse log (e.g. '📜 Blamey's Limerick Log'); falls back to 'Limerick Log'

verse.role: verse residue body under the personal limerick/verse log heading, verbatim

system_messages.role: ## Known System Messages bullets; each renders inline-code like `MSG: detail` — supply the text without backticks

system_messages_coda.role: verbatim non-list tail of Known System Messages (sign-off quotes, rules)

testimony.role: ## Field Testimony: one blockquote each; `note` may key a `notes` footnote

attribution.role: who said it, e.g. 'Blamey, post-crash analysis'

note.role: key into `notes`; renders a [^key] ref after the quote

field_notes.role: ## Field Notes: one block each, of the kind the server chose (callout, quote, list)

kind.role: block kind; the server picks it, copy it as given

text.role: callout kind: the note body, one short paragraph

line.role: quote kind: one verbatim line from a source, rendered as a blockquote

ledger.role: ## Provenance Ledger rows; the header (entry | detail) is fixed in the template

notes.role: footnotes: key -> note text, rendered as [^key]: defs under 'Annotations'. Every key must be referenced by some testimony `note`; the server picks the key and anchor, write the note text only, copied verbatim from a source

extra_sections.role: non-canon sections captured verbatim: {after: slot name or 'preamble', heading: text, level: 1|2, body: verbatim}. Extraction fills this; the ratchet never grows it
